chunks: A prohibition was issued against visiting the graves of Quraysh and al-Hayr. Then, after some months, the vizier summoned al-Bāqaṭāʾī and said to him: Meet Banū al-Furāt and the Bursiyyīn, and tell them not to visit the graves of Quraysh, for the Caliph has ordered that everyone who visits be searched for and arrested.

key_terms.الْحَيْرِ: al-Hayr, the sacred area associated with Karbala
key_terms.فَيُقْبَضَ عَلَيْهِ: then he is to be arrested or seized
key_terms.مَقَابِرِ قُرَيْشٍ: the graves of Quraysh, referring to the cemetery site
key_terms.يُتَفَقَّدَ: to be sought out, checked, or tracked down

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about the prohibition on visiting the graves of Quraysh and al-Hayr?
ai.summary: This report narrates a period in which a prohibition was issued against visiting the graves of Quraysh and al-Hayr, and government authorities moved to enforce it. It reflects political surveillance and the pressure placed upon Shi'a devotional visitation practices in that historical context.
